The average height of a Chinese man differs by the population definition used. For adult men aged 18–44 in 2020, the average was about 169.7 cm [d6]. For 19-year-old males in 2019, multiple high-credibility sources report an average of 175.7 cm [d4, d9]. Wikipedia’s page also lists estimated national averages ranging from 169.7 to 172.6 cm depending on the source and year [d1].
